buildings.name: The Lighthouse
buildings.note: Nobody remembers who built it. The lamp still works.

buildings.name: The Salt Kettle
buildings.note: Bakery by morning, tea room by afternoon.

buildings.name: Ambrose & Daughter
buildings.note: General store. The daughter is the one behind the counter now.

buildings.name: The Ferry Office
buildings.note: Sells tickets for a ferry that has not run in three years.

buildings.name: Town Hall
buildings.note: One room, one clerk, one clock that runs slow.

buildings.name: The Square
buildings.note: A bench, a pump, a lot of gulls.

buildings.name: The Pier End
buildings.note: Where the ferry would tie up, if there were a ferry.

buildings.name: Vesper Lighthouse
buildings.description: A tall white lighthouse at the harbor entrance, with a sweeping beam that guides fishing boats safely home.

buildings.name: The Brass Tide-Mark
buildings.note: A bronze rod set near the pier end, already wearing thin chalk rings where Sable Tide has measured the last two high waters.
